title: Chapter 968
paragraphs: Chapter 968
240. Crisis of the
Red Name Tribe (1)
The 4th City of the Red Name Tribe, Uslok.
The Great King Gaila was shaking as he kept receiving reports from his fellow tribesmen without a break.
"All the forces at Fortress No.3 have been annihilated, and we've lost contact with Fortresses No.5 and No.7. We believe they have also been completely destroyed!"
"Great King Gaila! You need to make a decision. If we continue like this, he will soon march towards Uslok...!"
The screens on the reporters' wristbands kept refreshing. These were video communications sent by those who
had barely survived the invasion and were fleeing.
{Haah, Huk! People of Uslok, you must run.}
{Uslok's location must have been exposed. Unless our god returns, it's impossible to resist him...!}
Crack! Crunch!
The screen within the wristband broke, cutting off the survivors' images and voices.
The last image Gaila and his staff saw was one of their tribesmen suddenly engulfed in flames during communication.
Those flames were now reducing all the fortresses under Uslok to ashes.
The fortresses and passages that the Red Name Tribe had prepared to strike at the royal palace, and all the troops on standby were being found and burned.
It was Elona's fire. She was single-handedly sweeping through the underground, wiping out the Red Name Tribesmen.
"Kinsmen, kinsmen! Damn it, what on earth...! Did those bastards manage to make a map of the underground?"
Gaila screamed, clutching his head as if he were tearing it apart.
Even though he hadn't been in a direct battle, his eyes were bloodshot from shock. He struggled to control his confusion and anger, and didn't know what decision to make.
"Is there still no proper contact with Shimat and the other Great Kings?"
The reporters nodded heavily. The communication failure continued.
They couldn't tell what tricks Elona was using, but she was nearly perfectly isolating Uslok and its sub-fortresses.
Communication with the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th cities was intermittent at best, and even then, the situation wasn't good enough for smooth communication.

'He did it on purpose... He only allows perfect communication occasionally with the fortresses connected to Uslok. Moreover, that's just to show us our surviving tribesmen getting killed while fleeing. He's trying to instill fear in us...!'
Crack! Gaila gritted her teeth and stared at the dark screen.

Ever since the Zechmig clan was released from the seal and reappeared on the ground, they had endured many humiliations. The first to awaken, Shymart and his party, happened to meet Jin directly and suffered a defeat. Later, both Rakiman Hog and Drekhon, the combat kings, were bitterly defeated by the Bamel Alliance.

In particular, the most significant humiliation was the death of Drekhon, who could amass a large amount of blood. As a result, the Zechmig clan lost their dominance in the alliance with the Royal Family, and they had to get nutrition only from Lutero, abandoning Hyuphuster.
Even then, it was not easy to get nutrition. Suddenly, a
wizard of Changsung was added to Zephyr, blocking the way of the Zechmig clan.

All of these would have been unimaginable in ancient times. The great Zechmig clan being pushed around by humans and Melca clan who were no better than bugs. Back then, even the Sinma Family had to keep an eye on the Zechmig and Cheongmyeong clans for survival.

'No, it can't be. We can't make mistakes again by being drunk on past glory and anger. Whether Elona Zephyr is underestimating us and intimidating us, or stepping on us and killing us like bugs, we need to make a cool judgment like our Shymart brethren.'
Soon, Gaila made a decision.
"All brethren below the rank of 2nd-class Combat King should prepare to retreat immediately!"
"Combat King brethren, do you intend for the Combat King brethren and those above the rank of 2nd-class Combat King to fight against him?"
"It may be better for the brethren below the rank of 2nd-class Combat King to stay and buy some time."

"No, we're going to retreat too. But it doesn't make sense to just back down. It would be right for those who can confront him to some extent if they build a proper formation, including myself, to confront him directly, gather information, and then retreat. Some losses are inevitable, but with me here, at least 70% of our brethren will be able to return alive."
Gaila believed he made a wise decision. He said that even if Shymart was here, he would have made the same decision.
"......Understood, Combat King brethren. Then, our scribes will stay in front of the dimension door until the retreat of our brethren is over, and wait for the Combat King brethren."
"Understood."

As the command was given, the relevant personnel began to prepare for the retreat. Once the fleet began to move, it would take about three hours to reach the dimension door leading to the other cities. It was a principle to destroy the dimension door last when giving up the city and retreating.
"Bring the best blood left in the city. Distribute it to all combat personnel according to the water supply."
The remaining Zechmig clan members brought the blood they had stored in the warehouse.
The blood was originally left for use in future battles with the Royal Family. Due to this incident, the Zechmig clan's release from the leash of the Royal Family was inevitably delayed.
"I will pray for luck, Combat King brethren."
"I apologize for leaving first, as soon as the communication disturbance is gone, we will immediately request support from other Combat King brethren."
The fleets within the city began to depart.
The sight of hundreds of fleets rising was a spectacle in itself. If there were no figures like Elona or Jin, these forces could have swiftly seized any significant region in an instant.
"......Now we check how he found our location, whether it's related to the completion of the Mask Stone."

Around the time when the fleets' figures were disappearing from the Usurok Castle, a sudden communication request came in through Gaila's bracelet. Gaila hurriedly accepted the communication and launched a window on the bracelet.
"Ogen Brother!"
Ogen Kam was a second-grade fighting king of the enemy clan and one of the first to wake from the seal with Shimat.
He was slower in his speech than the others who had communicated earlier, but he maintained a calm expression. However, his eyes were dilated as if he was drunk or dazed.
"Brother, what's going on? What's the situation there? Is Fortress No. 7 safe?"
{Gaila Toon......}
Ogen made Gaila uneasy with his mechanical voice. Something that looked like a wooden stem was wrapped around Ogen's head.
{Can we......run away?}
"Brother Ogen, what are you talking about suddenly?"
{Ogen's head......has a lot of information...... It makes it very easy for me to find and eliminate you thanks to him.}
Chills ran down Gaila's neck.
"You bastard, don't tell me you're Elona Jipel......!"
As Gaila responded, Ogen's body exploded and ashes scattered in the screen. Immediately afterwards, Elona's emotionless face appeared.
"This damn thing, what kind of mischief are you up to!"
{Gaila Toon, the Grand Fighting King who rules over the fourth city of the enemy clan, Usurok. What happened to the fleet you just sent to escape?}
Gaila's eyes widened.
The fleet should have already reached the portal safely, out of Gaila's sight and even beyond his perception.
However, Elona, who was much further away from the fleet than Gaila, already knew about the retreat.
Gaila reflexively launched another window on the bracelet and requested communication from the retreating fleet. There was no response at all.
"Did you...... already destroy the fleet......?"
Elona nodded her head.

{Like this bracelet, the fleet also had usable parts, so I didn't destroy all of it. However, the lower-ranking enemy clan forces are not valuable as biological golems for now, so I eliminated all of them.}

From the moment she began to invade Usurok, Elona used her infinite magic power to block all communications throughout Usurok. It was a reproduction of the 'authority of blocking' owned by the Biseptus family of the demon realm, reproduced purely with magic power.
And then Elona used the Holy Vessel to infiltrate the minds of the enemy clan members who had been captured by Jipel so far.
The powerful mind control ability of the Holy Vessel was not only applicable to Elona herself. She could also use the Holy Vessel on others.

Elona invaded the enemy clan based on the information obtained this way. From the lower-ranked enemy clan members imprisoned by Jipel, she confirmed the rough locations of each city and a few passages, and from the enemy clan members encountered in Usurok, she gathered detailed information.
Now, the only area Elona had to eliminate in this region was Usurok Castle.
Gaila glared at Elona, shedding red tears.
And suddenly, she realized. The landscape behind Elona, who was walking, looked very familiar.
She was already walking inside Usurok Castle, having annihilated all the fighting kings on the watchtower and outer walls.
While Elona infiltrated this far, Gaila could not sense her energy at all.
Crash-!
The door to the lord's room was broken. The moment it happened, Gaila jumped up and tried to throw a punch forward, but the light magic that poured from Elona's staff was faster.
"Cough!"

The light magic shot like a spear pierced Gaila's red heart crystal. The fighting kings nearby all glared at Elona, but they all fell helplessly under the shock of the exploding light spear stuck in Gaila's chest.
Gaila had originally planned to counterattack by spreading the castle transformation as soon as she received a report that Elona had arrived.
But that calculation was wrong from the start. Even if she fought with full preparation and transformed into the castle, Gaila could not match Elona.
"Gaila Toon, now you have to tell me. Information about other enemy clan grand fighting kings and their bases."
Trying to get up while holding onto the broken heart crystal, the newly formed light spears were already staked all over Gaila's body like pegs.

Through her blood-stained gaze, Gaila confirmed that dozens of stems that looked like tree roots were pouring out of the Holy Vessel that Elona was using. They were the stems wrapped around Ogen's head.
Those roots instantly eroded Gaila.
That was the last memory of the Grand Fighting King Gaila.
